fonts.missingGlyphs.english: The font {font} has no glyphs for these characters: {chars}. The burned-in subtitles would show empty boxes. Install a font that has these characters, then try again. Subtitle files (SRT, ASS) aren't affected, and you can still export them.

fonts.missingTargetGlyphs.english: The font {font} is missing glyphs that the {language} subtitles need: {chars}. The burned-in subtitles would show empty boxes. Install a font that supports {language}, then try again. Subtitle files (SRT, ASS) aren't affected, and you can still export them.

fonts.noJapaneseMac.english: This Mac has no font that can show Japanese subtitles (tried {fonts}), so burned-in Japanese would turn into empty boxes. Install a Japanese font (such as Hiragino Sans or Yu Gothic) with Font Book, then try again. Subtitle files (SRT, ASS) aren't affected, and you can still export them.

fonts.noJapaneseWindows.english: This computer has no font that can show Japanese subtitles (tried {fonts}), so burned-in Japanese would turn into empty boxes. Install a Japanese font (such as Yu Gothic or Meiryo) in "Settings > Personalization > Fonts", or add the Japanese supplemental fonts in "Settings > System > Optional features", then try again. Subtitle files (SRT, ASS) aren't affected, and you can still export them.

fonts.noTargetFont.english: This computer has no font that can show {language} subtitles (tried {fonts}), so the burned-in subtitles would show empty boxes. Install a font that supports {language}, then try again. Subtitle files (SRT, ASS) aren't affected, and you can still export them.

platform.unsupported.english: This app runs only on Windows (64-bit) and on Macs with Apple silicon (M1 or later). This computer is {system} {machine}. Intel Macs and Linux aren't supported yet.

profile.asrFallbackBlocked.english: ASR fallback:  unavailable, driver {installed} < {required}; update the NVIDIA driver (CUDA Toolkit not needed)

profile.cloudRecommended.english: Cloud LLM:     recommended, only after you opt in

profile.driverTooOld.english: Driver:        {installed} is too old for the {profile} profile. Update the NVIDIA driver to {required} or newer. The CUDA Toolkit is not needed.

profile.label.apple-cpu.english: Apple silicon, CPU only, no GPU acceleration

profile.label.metal-32gb.english: Apple silicon, 32 GB or more, one model at a time

profile.label.metal-32gb-parallel.english: Apple silicon, 32 GB or more, both models at once

profile.lowRam.english: RAM warning:   {installed} MiB is below the {recommended} MiB the local 8B model needs; use a cloud LLM or expect swapping

profile.oneAtATime.english: Stages:        run one after the other; the ASR exits before the LLM loads

profile.why.memoryFits.english: Why:           This profile was chosen by the Mac's unified memory size, not by a measurement.

profile.why.memoryTooSmall.english: Why:           The Mac has less memory than the smallest Metal profile needs.

profile.why.memoryUnknown.english: Why:           The Mac's memory size could not be read.

profile.why.noNvidiaGpu.english: Why:           No NVIDIA GPU was found, so GPU runtimes are not used.

profile.why.vramFits.english: Why:           The GPU has enough VRAM for this profile.

profile.why.vramTooSmall.english: Why:           The GPU has less VRAM than the smallest GPU profile needs.

profile.why.vramUnknown.english: Why:           An NVIDIA GPU was found but its VRAM could not be read.

render.noH264Mac.english: The ffmpeg on this Mac has no usable H.264 encoder, so the subtitles can't be burned into the video. In Terminal, run brew install ffmpeg to install the full ffmpeg, then try again. Subtitle files (SRT, ASS) aren't affected, and you can still export them.

render.noH264Windows.english: Windows on this computer has no H.264 encoder, so the subtitles can't be burned into the video. In "Settings > System > Optional features", install "Media Feature Pack" (only Windows N and KN editions need it), or run Windows Update, then try again. Subtitle files (SRT, ASS) aren't affected, and you can still export them.

runtime.foundElsewhere.english: The app didn't delete {program}: it was found in {where}, not in the app's runtimes folder ({folder}). To remove it, do that yourself (if you installed it with Homebrew, use brew uninstall).

runtime.localBuild.english: There's no ready-made {engine} program to download for this platform, so you need to build it once on this computer. In the project folder, run {script} (the steps are in docs/MACOS.md). The built {program} goes in {folder}. The app also finds it on your PATH.

runtime.vcMissing.english: This computer doesn't have the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64), so the speech recognition and translation programs can't start. Go to {url} to download and install "vc_redist.x64.exe", then try again.

secrets.cloudKeyUnavailable.english: This version can't save a cloud API key on a Mac yet. Use the local model (the default) or Ollama instead. Saving cloud keys will come later.
